WPSS No.94 of 2024 
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
 Ms. Neetu Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner, is 
present. 
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned counsel for the respondents. 
3. Heard. 
4. By means of this petition, petitioner has sought 
indulgence of this Court for a direction to the respondents to 
make fixation of salary of petitioner after sanctioning the A.C.P. 
Grade Pay as is being paid to other junior employees of the 
petitioner’s cadre and other ancillary relief. 
5. Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and is 
allowed four weeks’ time to file counter affidavit. 
6. List on 16.04.2024. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
